_comment: What each day produces, in IST. The cron in .github/workflows/post.yml fires every day at 19:37 IST. 'film' is the daily generated reel: Veo footage of a candidate, then the real interface card and the price card. English only by the owner's decision (11 Sep 2026). 'reel', 'carousel' and 'image' remain available for manual runs.

reel._why: Each reel starts with an 8-second Veo hook, followed by roughly 17 to 22 seconds of narrated product cards. Keep the complete reel near 25 to 30 seconds for completion rate.

film._why: Two footage beats (about 8s and 7s) plus two cards. Completion rate is what earns reach.
